title: Life flask
wikitext:
'''Life flasks''' are an [[item class]] and a subtype of [[flask]]s which [[Recovery|recovers]] [[life]] over time. The flask ends its effect if maximum Life is reached. They also queue up if multiple [[flasks]] are active.
